🌟 google-play-scraper | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Scraping Google Play Store data for market research, ASO, competitor tracking, and review monitoring.
✨ Key Features: • Scrape app details, search results, top charts, developer pages, similar apps, user reviews, permissions, and data safety. • Fully typed results with runtime validation using Zod schemas. • Runs on native Node.js fetch (no external HTTP dependency).
📖 Summary: This Node.js library provides a fully typed TypeScript API to scrape data from the Google Play Store. It allows developers to fetch app details, search results, reviews, and more, serving as a modern, robust alternative to older scrapers.
